title: The Cabbage Merchant vs Yidris vs Kinnan vs Rog/Thras | CEDH Gameplay

players.note: confirmed from on-screen overlays via video frame sampling 2026-08-24; intro captions say 'Brian' but every overlay reads RYAN

extraction.method: manual LLM read of cleaned auto-captions (data/transcripts/Bq-nFi0f1jA.txt), plus targeted video frame sampling (yt-dlp --download-sections + ffmpeg stills) at 01:50, 07:10-07:28, 13:20-13:48, 20:50-21:03 for overlays, card popups, turn counter, and life totals
caveats: Auto-captions only; card names are garbled and repaired against the four decklists in decks/Bq-nFi0f1jA/; each repair is flagged.

The provided kinnan.txt is NOT the deck Alex played: the video Kinnan is a big-creature toolbox build (Ghalta, Great Oak Guardian, Thorn Mammoth, Elvish Piper, Jin-Gitaxias, Derevi, Thassa's Oracle, Void Winnower, Gigantoplasm, Nykthos, Strip Mine, Relic of Legends, Barkchannel Pathway, Worldly Tutor - none of which appear in kinnan.txt). Kinnan-seat card names are flagged as divergences and could not be decklist-verified.

The published Rog/Thras list also drifts from the video (Malevolent Rumble, Six, Hedron Crab, Croaking Counterpart, Hedge Maze, Prismatic Vista, Windswept Heath, Aftermath Analyst, snow-covered Island seen on camera but absent from rog_thrasios.txt).
PWP edits heavily (21 min for 3 duels); some turns are cut, so intra-round ordering in games 1 and 3 is best-effort.
The 'TURN NN' overlay counts table rounds from the seat-1 player's untap; frame-confirmed at each win moment.

games.seat_order_confidence: high; intro names Alex as starting player and every play matches deck-specific cards
games.win_method: Seedborn Muse (Finale of Devastation X=5 on turn 3) plus a Biomancer's Familiar copy let Alex activate Kinnan every turn cycle; on Ryan's turn 4 a Derevi, Empyrial Tactician hit plus Great Oak Guardian flicker/untap loop made infinite mana, Kinnan activations put Thrasios then Thassa's Oracle onto the battlefield, Thrasios drew the deck to 6 cards, Oracle ETB won. Frame-confirmed TURN 04 overlay at the win.
